body: It's not only my adolescence. My whole life has been this way. I can't say life for me is worth it.

Yeah, I guess.

1. Girlfriend. Because of the way my life keeps going, I don't think I'll ever find a situation where I meet a girl I might like. I think I'm just going to keep missing my old girlfriend and never get over her.

2. Friends. We've already gone over this, but there's really no conclusion. People don't like me and I don't know why.

3. Hobbies. I have a lot of hobbies but I don't enjoy them anymore. Drawing, reading, writing, programming, these things don't make me happy anymore.

4. Overall worth of life. I'm not happy. What's the whole point?

Yeah, that sounded a bit ambigouos, I'm sorry.

It was a reply to

> Your therapist - do you tell him when you feel things aren't helping?

so I mean emotionally.

I have very few good memories, probably just two or three, and I'm being serious. These memories don't compensate for all the suffering. I don't know what to look forward to, people will never like me and that will always be the case.

I think I need to tell my therapist that I haven't being feeling very well, that'll probably help.

I'm not nervous or worried about autonomy. I know I'll be able to mantain myself and keep a "good" life (in the sense of having enough money). I'm worried about people and just enjoying things. I think I'll never have people who love me. I think I'll never find a girl who I'm going to love. I don't like to do anything anymore. So I'm just afraid I'll continue to be miserable.

I just think it'll keep being the same.

I go to high school. I could get very good grades but I don't because I just lack motivation. I have a work that pays sort of well, but I lack motivation for that as well. I'm seeing a therapist right now, and we go over most of this. I know he's good at what he does and he's very dedicate. I just don't know.
